comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
I may have mentioned it earlier in-game, but I will do it again...

When you've discovery from map, then you won't receive this discovery map again until you've reported the discovery to a NPC in exchange for rewards (ducats, QMP and social skill prof). Here is then the thing, don't report any of them and you won't receive those maps again, hence this makes this oxford skill not essential at some point.

Although in pre-industry this would been too difficult since Quest Mediation Permits were scarce that time, but thanks to the introduction of Union along with their shop it is much easier to get those permits. Therefor, applying this method is now feasible.

Hope this helps ^^

Kind Regards,

Huseyin_Gazi
